name: Inudou Chihaya
source:
She is the Kizumori shrine's exorcist shrine maiden.
She has a friendly and cheerful personality, but she also acts with firm conviction.
She has been given several years of free time to gain experience outside, while also traveling in pursuit of a rival who left the shrine and became a free agent.

This time, she will be exterminating monsters in a village she stopped at during her journey.

Kagura Reimeiki ~Chihaya no Shou~ San Profile

A freelance exorcist shrine maiden who loves training.
She has a friendly and cheerful personality, but acts with firm conviction. She
was a former exorcist shrine maiden affiliated with Kizumori Shrine, but due to various circumstances she became a freelancer.
Her cooking skills used to make incredible objects, but thanks to the guidance of her best friend Murasaki, she has improved to the point where she can still eat them as long as she is careful. She
loves to exercise, so her large, voluptuous breasts are a source of concern. She
is said to be a descendant of one of the people who once sealed away the Great Tengu at Kizumori Shrine.
